mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::the_zoom_readout_follows_its_signal`; `::the_fps_readout_follows_its_signal` -- each changes the signal after the mount and reads the DOM after a reactive tick
statement: A control MUST follow its signal when the value changes, not only when it mounts.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_toggle_reports_its_click_and_waits_for_the_value` -- the click is reported and the pressed state stays put until the test writes the answer
statement: A control MUST NOT change the state it displays: the click leaves as a report and the value comes back from the Logic thread.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_modal_follows_its_signal_and_holds_the_loop_while_open` -- the shared modal takes the shell's hold on open; ci-gate -- `scripts/crate_boundaries.py` refuses a `<dialog` outside `crates/ambre-chrome/src/dialog.rs`, so no modal opens without it
statement: A modal MUST suspend the frame loop while it is open.
Setting a modal's open signal MUST show the element.
Clearing a modal's open signal MUST hide the element.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_backdrop_click_dismisses_the_modal_and_clears_its_signal`; `::a_native_close_clears_the_signal_and_the_modal_reopens` -- Escape is the browser's own close, which the second test drives
statement: Escape and a click on the backdrop MUST close a modal.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_backdrop_click_dismisses_the_modal_and_clears_its_signal`; `::a_native_close_clears_the_signal_and_the_modal_reopens` -- the second opens the modal again after the dismissal
statement: A dismissed modal MUST clear its signal.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_modal_follows_its_signal_and_holds_the_loop_while_open`; `::a_backdrop_click_dismisses_the_modal_and_clears_its_signal`; `::an_open_modal_unmounted_releases_the_loop` -- each close path returns the hold; `ambre_canvas::frame::tests::a_closed_modal_resumes_only_what_it_suspended` -- a release keeps the loop paused while the route is away
statement: Closing a modal MUST NOT leave the frame loop suspended.

mechanism: `ambre_chrome::chrome_ui::a_burst_runs_once_with_its_last_value`; ci-gate -- `scripts/crate_boundaries.py` refuses a range or colour input in a UI-thread file that names no `Debouncer`
statement: A control driven by a drag MUST coalesce the burst into one command.
Coalescing a burst MUST NOT drop its last value.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::tests::the_asynchronous_item_carries_everything_the_copy_published` -- the written item, read back, holds the mirror and the private type
statement: The clipboard MUST carry a `text/plain` mirror plus one app-agnostic private type.

mechanism: `ambre_bus::clipboard_tests::only_the_launcher_names_a_clipboard_type` -- the code of every crate is scanned, and a private type spelled outside the launcher fails it
statement: An application MUST NOT define a clipboard type of its own.

mechanism: `ambre_bus::clipboard_tests::a_paste_takes_the_kept_copy_only_on_the_token`; structural -- `ClipboardBlob::source` is the one site, and Trame, Toile and Prose each call it
statement: Every view MUST choose between the copy it kept and what the browser read through one shared rule, and a plain paste MUST take the read.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::pipe::tests::a_paste_event_and_the_paste_button_end_in_one_call` -- a raised `paste` event and a button press each end in the host's one paste call
statement: Every paste affordance MUST reach the view through one path, whatever the gesture that raised it.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::pipe::tests::a_paste_event_and_the_paste_button_end_in_one_call` -- both paths reach a host that names no application. Structural: `pipe::wire_pipe` and `pipe::button_paste` take any `PipeHost`, so no application type is in reach
statement: The host MUST NOT name an application on a clipboard path: it MUST address the active view.

mechanism: `ambre_trame::logic::tests::group7::copy_range_covers_the_full_selection_not_a_viewport` -- Trame's half. `ambre_toile::ui::view::view_tests::a_copy_names_the_whole_selection_and_sends_nothing_else` -- Toile's half, an id past the viewport included
statement: A copy MUST be built by the Logic thread from the whole document, never culled to what the viewport holds.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::pipe::tests::a_deferred_copy_writes_the_token_alone_and_prevents_the_default` -- a raised `copy` event ends prevented, with no `text/plain` written
statement: A deferred copy MUST prevent the browser default, so an empty write never clobbers what the clipboard already holds.

mechanism: `ambre_belt::trame::tests::a_deferred_copy_writes_inside_the_activation_window` -- a trusted `Ctrl+C` copies a range, the page reads the activation where it calls the write, and the clipboard then holds the private type and the token; `::a_copy_held_past_the_activation_window_writes_outside_it` -- the control: the Logic thread held past the window, the same reading says the window lapsed
statement: The clipboard write MUST happen inside the user activation window the copy opened.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::tests::the_asynchronous_item_carries_everything_the_copy_published` -- the item, read back, holds the mirror, the prefixed private type and the ownership token
statement: Where the browser accepts the `web ` types, the asynchronous write MUST publish everything the copy event published, so it never removes what the copy established.

mechanism: Trame `ambre_trame::logic::tests::group7::copy_range_covers_the_full_selection_not_a_viewport` -- it asserts the outcome carries no delta; Prose `ambre_prose::input_tests::a_copy_leaves_the_document_unchanged` -- the text reads back unchanged; Toile `ambre_toile::ui::view::view_tests::a_copy_names_the_whole_selection_and_sends_nothing_else` -- the copy request goes alone, and the Logic thread answers it for display only
statement: A copy MUST NOT change the document.

mechanism: `ambre_toile::ui::view::view_tests::a_cut_whose_copy_went_nowhere_deletes_nothing`; `ambre_trame::ui::view::view_tests::a_cut_whose_copy_went_nowhere_arms_nothing`; `ambre_prose::input_tests::a_refused_copy_deletes_nothing` -- each drives a copy the channel refuses, and no delete follows

sources.note: cut is each application's own policy

statement: A cut whose copy fails MUST delete nothing.

mechanism: `ambre_bus::clipboard_tests::a_paste_takes_the_kept_copy_only_on_the_token` -- the same text without the token serves the read
statement: A paste MUST decide same-tab full fidelity on the ownership token the copy wrote, never by comparing the `text/plain` mirror.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::pipe::tests::a_paste_after_a_landed_write_reads_the_clipboard_back` -- the browser's read answers with the item a landed write leaves, and the paste decides on its token
statement: A paste raised after the copy's asynchronous write landed MUST read the clipboard back, so the token and the private bytes that write moved still decide it.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::tests::a_browser_refusing_the_web_types_still_gets_the_mirror_and_the_html` -- a constructor refusing the `web ` types gets a second item with the mirror and the marked HTML
statement: Where the browser refuses the `web ` types, the asynchronous write MUST still publish the mirror and the HTML.

mechanism: `ambre_bus::clipboard_tests::the_token_reads_back_from_the_marked_html` -- the token's round trip, through the HTML as Firefox 156 hands it back
statement: A copy that writes HTML MUST carry its ownership token in that HTML, and the token MUST read back from it.

gap: unbuilt -- lands with the `A same-tab paste on a browser refusing the web types` Story (`ambre-roadmap.md` E9). The token rides in the HTML alone, so a copy without HTML, every Trame and Toile copy, loses rung 2 on such a browser
statement: Where the browser refuses the `web ` types, a same-tab paste MUST still reach rung 2.

mechanism: `ambre_toile::ui::view::view_tests::a_paste_takes_the_highest_rung_it_can_serve`; `ambre_trame::ui::view::view_tests::a_paste_takes_the_highest_rung_it_can_serve` -- each offers two rungs at once and reads which one answered
statement: A paste MUST take the fidelity ladder in one order, first match wins.
A paste MUST NOT skip a rung it can serve.

mechanism: `ambre_app::host::pipe::tests::a_paste_writes_nothing_to_the_clipboard` -- the host half. `ambre_toile::ui::view::view_tests::a_paste_writes_nothing_back`; `ambre_trame::ui::view::view_tests::a_paste_writes_nothing_back` -- a paste leaves no blob for the host to write
statement: A paste MUST NOT change what the clipboard holds.

mechanism: `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_clipboard_intents_carry_the_shared_identity`; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::the_clipboard_intents_carry_the_shared_identity` -- each reads the shared identity off its own application's table; `ambre_commands::tests::the_keymap_binds_no_browser_serviced_chord`; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_keymap_binds_no_clipboard_chord` -- the other half, that no chord table decodes them a second time
statement: Copy, cut and paste MUST resolve through shared identities, in every application.

mechanism: `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_clipboard_intents_carry_the_shared_identity`; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::the_clipboard_intents_carry_the_shared_identity` -- each asserts both chord families of the three intents against the one shared identity, so a legacy chord naming a second command fails
statement: The legacy copy, cut and paste chords MUST name the same identities as the modern ones.

mechanism: `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::every_command_has_a_label`; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::every_exposed_identity_is_described` -- each walks its application's table and fails on a command whose label is empty; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::every_layout_row_resolves_in_the_registry`; `ambre_toile::ui::menu_bar::tests::every_dropdown_row_is_described` -- a laid-out command the table does not describe; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect`; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect`; `ambre_prose::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect` -- each table through `table_defects`, which `ambre_commands::tests::a_table_names_each_missing_part_of_a_description` shows refusing a duplicate identity, a missing title, a missing group and a blank icon
statement: A command MUST carry one description of its label, its icon, its chord and its grouping.

mechanism: `chrome_ui::the_toolbar_announces_the_registry_labels` -- the DOM belt queries the rendered `aria-label` of eleven identities against the registry title, so a literal written into Trame's format bar fails; `ambre_toile::tests::chrome_ui::the_button_bars_announce_the_registry_labels` -- the same query over Toile's tool palette, zoom cluster and selection toolbar; `ambre_prose::tests::chrome_panel::the_format_bar_announces_the_registry_labels` -- the same query over Prose's format bar; type-level -- a menu row's fields are private and its one constructor takes the command's description, so no menu or context-menu row can carry a label of its own
statement: Every view of a command MUST take what it shows from that description, and never declare a label of its own.

mechanism: type-level -- the chord table is a map keyed by the chord, so a second command bound to a chord replaces the first rather than joining it, and a table holding two commands on one chord does not exist; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::declared_chords_are_distinct`; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::declared_chords_are_distinct` -- no declared default is the one the map would drop
statement: A chord MUST resolve to at most one command.

mechanism: `ambre_toile::ui::palette::tests::tool_chords_are_distinct` -- the eight tool chords of one application; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect`; `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect`; `ambre_prose::commands::tests::the_table_has_no_defect` -- every declared table, where `table_defects` names two entries on one default chord, as `ambre_commands::tests::a_table_names_each_missing_part_of_a_description` drives
statement: Two commands MUST NOT declare the same default chord.

mechanism: crate-graph -- its dependency table is empty, so a framework type has no path into it and the crate builds and tests on the host
statement: The crate that owns command identity MUST depend on no user-interface framework.

mechanism: type-level -- a chord's modifier set carries one accelerator bit and no way to name the control and the command keys apart, so no table can declare one platform's chord; `ambre_commands::keybinding::tests::the_control_key_and_the_command_key_fold_into_one_chord` -- the fold itself, which is the one function that still reads the two bits
statement: One chord table MUST serve every platform: the primary accelerator MUST fold the control and the command modifiers.

mechanism: `ambre_commands::tests::keymap_resolves_default_bindings` -- it seeds from a command table and asserts the bound chord answers with that command's identity
statement: A chord the table binds MUST resolve to the command it was bound to.

mechanism: type-level -- the resolve takes the table by shared reference and the map has no interior mutability, so a resolution that binds, rebinds or drops an entry does not compile
statement: Resolving a chord MUST NOT change the table.

mechanism: `ambre_commands::tests::keymap_resolves_default_bindings` -- two of its assertions ask for an unbound chord and a bound chord under an extra modifier, and both must answer with nothing
statement: A chord the table does not bind MUST resolve to no command.

mechanism: `ambre_commands::tests::rebinding_reports_the_displaced_command` -- its first assertion reads back the displaced identity, which is what a conflict notice would show
statement: A rebinding MUST report the command it displaced.

mechanism: `ambre_commands::tests::a_rebinding_leaves_every_other_chord_alone` -- every chord the rebinding did not name resolves to the command it resolved to before
statement: A rebinding MUST NOT change the command any other chord resolves to.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::each_update_takes_a_clock_above_every_one_used` -- two successive updates take two rising clocks, and a reopened document resumes above the echo of its own last frame
statement: An outbound update MUST carry a clock strictly greater than every clock this client has already used for the document.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::an_announced_snapshot_releases_nothing_until_fetched`; `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_snapshot_that_does_not_open_stays_unknown` -- an announced snapshot releases no held delta until it is downloaded and opened
statement: A snapshot MUST NOT be registered as a known parent before its contents reach the Logic thread.

mechanism: `ambre_core::id::tests::every_client_derives_the_same_genesis_parent` -- the derivation is pinned to the document's own bytes, so a change to it fails here
statement: Every client MUST derive the same parent for a document that has never been snapshotted.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::quarantine_released_in_clock_order` -- several updates held behind one unknown parent, and the release order read back
statement: Released updates MUST be applied in parent-snapshot then clock order.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::update_with_known_snapshot_delivered_immediately` -- the delivery that makes the quarantine an exception rather than a stage every delta passes through
statement: An update whose parent snapshot is known MUST be delivered immediately.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_quarantine_overflow_drops_the_lowest_clock` -- the lowest clock arrives neither first nor last and waits on one of two parents, so a drop by arrival or by parent fails
statement: A quarantine overflow MUST drop the oldest entry.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::quarantine_overflow_drops_oldest_and_warns` -- its warning count, one at the hard cap, so a warning per further arrival fails
statement: A quarantine overflow MUST emit exactly one warning.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_quarantined_update_is_not_opened_on_arrival` -- an update sealed under a key this client lacks is held, and its arrival raises no failure to open
statement: Receiving an update MUST NOT open one it quarantines.

mechanism: type-level -- Toile's and Prose's remote paths answer display events and no outcome, so neither has a field a delta could leave by; Prose `ambre_prose::logic::convergence_tests::a_remote_change_is_never_re_broadcast`; Toile `ambre_toile::logic::convergence_tests::a_remote_change_is_never_re_broadcast`; Trame `ambre_trame::logic::tests::group3::a_remote_change_is_never_re_broadcast` -- in each, the next local delta carries none of the remote peer's operations
statement: A remote change MUST NOT be re-broadcast.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::update_with_unknown_snapshot_quarantined` -- the update is held and the Logic thread is handed nothing
statement: An update whose parent snapshot is unknown MUST be quarantined, never applied.
The post-open replay MUST start after the last delta the downloaded snapshot already contains.
A document MUST be reported ready once per open, after its first replay has landed.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_history_replay_reaches_logic_as_one_batch` -- a replay of five deltas yields exactly one batch event carrying the five payloads in order, and no single-delta event
statement: A history replay MUST reach the Logic thread as one batch, never as one event per delta.

mechanism: `ambre_logic::replay::tests::a_long_replay_lands_in_slices_and_yields_between_them` -- each pass imports at most a slice, the loop comes back unasked, and the end of the replay waits for the last slice
statement: The Logic thread MUST import a history replay in slices that each fit the frame budget, and yield between them.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::the_quarantine_asks_once_per_gap` -- arrivals held behind one gap send a single history request for it
statement: The quarantine MUST ask the relay for the missing history once per gap, not once per arrival.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::an_open_sends_no_update` -- with a snapshot to read or without one, the open sends a history request and no update
statement: Opening a document MUST NOT emit an update.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::websocket::tests::a_reconnect_resubscribes_and_pulls_every_relay_document` -- the open event, driven over the mock transport, subscribes exactly the documents the relay created and skips the one it never saw
statement: A reconnect MUST resubscribe every document that exists on the relay.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::websocket::tests::a_reconnect_resubscribes_and_pulls_every_relay_document` -- each subscribed document is asked for what lies past its own cursor, so a pull from zero or from another document's cursor fails
statement: A reconnect MUST pull what each document missed.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_reload_takes_its_clock_from_the_echo_of_its_own_update` -- the echo of its own clock-41 update moves the counter, a peer's clock 99 does not, and the next frame leaves with clock 42
statement: A reload MUST recover the clock from the relay's echo of this client's own updates.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_reconnect_replay_applies_nothing_twice` -- a replay overlapping a broadcast already received delivers the overlap once, and a held copy is not held twice
statement: A reconnect MUST NOT apply an update the client already applied.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::a_delta_refused_for_its_clock_leaves_again_with_every_later_one` -- the answer leaves first, then the refused delta and the later one at the expected clock and the next, and a late refusal sends its answer alone; `ambre_sync::rekey::tests::a_clock_refusal_returns_the_delta_and_every_later_one` -- the log gives back the refused delta and every later one, and a refusal of a delta already taken back gives back nothing
statement: A delta the relay refuses for its clock MUST be sealed again at the next free clock and sent again, with every delta sent after it, in order.

mechanism: `ambre_sync::updates::tests::the_echo_of_another_sessions_delta_confirms_nothing_here` -- an echo of the same author and clock, under another signature, leaves the delta in the log; `ambre_sync::rekey::tests::an_echo_at_the_same_clock_from_another_session_confirms_nothing` -- the log confirms by signature alone
statement: The echo of another session's delta MUST NOT confirm a delta this session sent at the same clock.

mechanism: `ambre_canvas::theme::stylesheet_tests::the_shell_stylesheet_spells_out_no_colour_and_no_scale` -- every declaration of the shell sheet is read, and a colour, a spacing, a radius or a type size spelled out fails it with its line; `ambre_canvas::theme::stylesheet_tests::the_literal_check_catches_each_kind_and_spares_a_token` -- the check catches a literal of each kind and spares a token, a zero, a hairline and a comment
statement: Every colour, spacing, radius and type size the interface uses MUST be declared in the one token source.

mechanism: target-build -- the drawing crate includes the generated constants and the generated sheet as files the build step writes, so neither exists unless that step ran and read the source
statement: The stylesheet and the drawing constants MUST both be generated from that source, in one build step.

mechanism: `ambre_canvas::theme::stylesheet_tests::the_stylesheet_reads_only_declared_tokens` -- every name the shell sheet reads is checked against the names the token source emits and the sheet declares
statement: A stylesheet MUST NOT read a token the source does not emit and the sheet does not declare.
The unmarked stylesheet MUST carry the light set, so a page that never sets the theme attribute renders light rather than unstyled.

mechanism: `ambre_app::platform::tests::a_theme_switch_reaches_both_halves` -- one switch, read back from the control and the document attribute, in the browser tier
statement: A theme switch MUST reach the browser half and the drawing half together, from one act.

mechanism: `ambre_canvas::theme::stylesheet_tests::a_theme_switch_changes_no_scale` -- the dark block declares colours and effects alone
statement: A theme switch MUST NOT change a spacing, a radius or a type size.

mechanism: `ambre_core::docfile::tests::round_trip_is_the_identity_on_the_container`; `ambre_trame::logic::docfile::tests::round_trip_preserves_the_document_state`; `::round_trip_is_byte_identical_on_a_bare_document`; `ambre_toile::logic::state::docfile::tests::round_trip_preserves_the_document_state`; `::a_round_trip_keeps_the_history_whole`; `fixture_determinism::the_round_trip_is_stable_on_every_doc_state_variant`; `ambre_logic::dispatch::tests::a_saved_file_opens_back_as_the_document_that_was_saved` -- the save and open gestures, edited first
statement: A `.ambre` round trip MUST be the identity on document state, leaving nothing a warning list could report: the payload **is** the document.

mechanism: crate-graph -- `ambre-core` declares no crypto and no compression dependency, so neither is reachable from the container
statement: The container layer MUST NOT compress or encrypt: the two entry points are pure functions over bytes, and protection is a separate stage.

mechanism: `ambre_core::docfile::tests::header_layout_is_the_spec_layout` -- it pins the 22-byte layout, and one writer takes the type as a parameter, so a per-app variant has nowhere to be written; `ambre_logic::dispatch::tests::a_saved_file_carries_the_document_id_the_registry_keyed_it_under` -- each application's save reads back through the one reader
statement: There MUST be one container for every app: the only app-dependent value in the header is the `doc_type` byte.

mechanism: `ambre_logic::dispatch::tests::a_snapshot_on_the_wire_carries_no_container_header` -- `SnapshotNeeded` is the one path that hands a snapshot to Sync, and the test reads the payload the dispatcher sends and refuses `AMBRE_MAGIC` in its first four bytes; structural -- the sealing entry point answers `RestEvent::DocFileSealed` to the surface that asked, so its bytes reach a download and never a relay message
statement: A snapshot on the wire MUST NOT carry this header: the container is a file format, never a wire format.

mechanism: `fixtures_gate::a_superseded_container_version_with_no_frozen_artifact_fails_the_gate`; `::a_version_retention_has_moved_past_owes_nothing` -- `just fixtures-check` refuses a kept version with no frozen artifact, and asks nothing of a version retention has moved past
statement: A superseded container version the retention window keeps MUST have one frozen artifact per generated `doc_type`.

mechanism: ci-gate -- `scripts/freeze_provenance.py`, run by `just freeze-provenance` in the CI `lint` job, which resolves each frozen artifact to the commit that added it. The live manifest must name the frozen version just before that commit and a greater one at it, so a freeze taken a commit late or with no bump is refused. A commit raising the container version must freeze every document type the live corpus held
statement: A version bump MUST freeze one named artifact per `doc_type` in the same commit that adds the registry row.

mechanism: `ambre_core::docfile::tests::the_sealed_layout_is_the_spec_layout` -- the 45-byte header and its version byte; `::the_plaintext_reader_refuses_a_sealed_file_by_name`; `::the_sealed_parser_refuses_a_plaintext_file_by_name` -- the two refusals that make the version the discriminator; `::an_unknown_sealed_layout_is_refused_without_a_migration_promise`; `::migrating_a_sealed_version_says_it_is_sealed`; `::a_truncated_sealed_header_is_rejected_at_every_length` -- the reader on inputs it must not guess at; `::a_sealed_round_trip_recovers_the_envelope`
statement: A passphrase-sealed file MUST carry its own container version; it MUST NOT be a flag on an existing one.

mechanism: `ambre_toile::ui::commands::tests::the_save_label_says_the_file_is_not_encrypted`; `ambre_trame::ui::commands::tests::the_save_label_says_the_file_is_not_encrypted` -- asserted on the command's label, the one string a user reads before clicking, rather than on a tooltip or a dialog, so a surface that drops the warning cannot compile green
statement: The export surface MUST state that a plaintext file carries no encryption of its own.

mechanism: `ambre_logic::dispatch::tests::a_sealed_export_hands_the_plaintext_to_sync_and_nothing_to_the_ui`; `ambre_sync::integration::a_sealed_file_round_trips_through_the_service_plane` -- the worker's own half; cargo-deny -- `ambre-core`, `ambre-logic`, `ambre-toile` and `ambre-trame` declare no crypto dependency, so neither an application nor the container layer can seal anything
statement: Sealing and opening a file MUST run in the Sync worker.

mechanism: `ambre_logic::dispatch::tests::the_sealed_bytes_come_back_as_the_application_s_own_export_event`; `::a_failed_seal_answers_a_failure_and_no_file`; `::a_document_closed_mid_seal_drops_the_answer` -- the one event on all three outcomes
statement: A sealed export MUST reach the user through the event its plaintext export already uses.
A reader MUST identify the file from `doc_type` and `version`, before any app-specific parsing.
A version older than the binary's MUST migrate on read.

mechanism: type-level -- both entry points take a byte slice, so there is no path, no name and no extension in scope to branch on
statement: A reader MUST NOT consult the file's name or extension.
No error path MUST mutate the bytes it was handed.
A version newer than the binary's MUST be refused cleanly.
